paragraphs.text: Gishath , "Sun's Avatar" is a legendary Dinosaur Avatar on the plane of Ixalan .

Gishath is an avatar of the Threefold Sun . He is 40-50 feet tall, 200 feet long and has the symbol of the Threefold Sun in the pattern of the feathers on his chest. He embodies all three aspects of the sun (creative, nourishing, and destructive) in one form, earning a mix of reverence and fear from those who seek to harness his strength against their enemies.
By 5 Dawn Era , his firstborn child Itzquinth was hatched.
